tiers.name: The Crown
tiers.feel: the tower's top: governing families, high academies, Aether grid control rooms, the spaceport

tiers.name: The High Turns
tiers.feel: wealthy rings: corporate arcologies, galleries, Off-world House estates

tiers.name: The Bulk
tiers.feel: the working heart: markets, foundries, transit, most of the population

tiers.name: The Low Turns
tiers.feel: old districts, overgrown machinery, Aether bleeding into everything; refugee communities

tiers.name: The Deepwell
tiers.feel: the chasm where the Aether rises: half-ruined and raw, with Aether strong enough to sicken almost anyone

species.name: Light elf
species.drawable: long pointed ears, luminous pale or golden eyes, faint shimmering glyph-like markings, tall and elegant, pale to light bronze skin

species.name: Deep elf
species.drawable: long pointed ears, reflective eyes, faintly glowing bioluminescent markings, deep violet to midnight black skin

species.name: Goblin
species.drawable: short but clearly adult in build and features, large expressive ears, sharp teeth, green to grey-blue skin

species.name: Golem
species.drawable: synthetic skin or panels, visible seams, rune-circuitry glowing beneath translucent panels, eyes with an inner rune-light, a glowing rune-core; always built in adult form

factions.name: The Spire Council
factions.summary: the official government; real power sits in the Crown

factions.name: The Aether Grid Corporation
factions.summary: controls the flow of Aether upward; partly owned by off-world money

factions.name: The Phoenix Academy
factions.summary: Aether research and the center of the philosophical debate; rediscovering what was lost in the Burn

factions.name: The Garden Guard
factions.summary: the Animist order; guards the Aether's source; sees the grid as exploitation; peaceful to radical

factions.name: The Off-world Houses
factions.summary: galactic aristocratic families with business interests here

factions.name: House Sarrant
factions.summary: an old off-world House with a large share of the Grid

factions.name: The refugee networks
factions.summary: mutual-aid groups, and sometimes resistance cells

factions.name: The Drowned Saints
factions.summary: the Ninth Turn's syndicate; hold the lower stairs and take a tithe

factions.name: The Couriers
factions.summary: neutral messengers and smugglers who work for anyone in any tier

currency.name: cinders
currency.note: metal coins digitally imprinted with credit values; credits are the galactic standard
